blurb: Book A Boat offers rentals of powerboats, kayaks, paddleboards, canoes, Sunfish sailboats, and an O'Day Daysailor II sailboat. They provide both single and double kayaks, stand up paddleboards, and captained private charters for sightseeing and bay cruising. Rentals are based in Menemsha on Martha's Vineyard with options for delivery for three days or more at no extra charge.
